props.name: preset
props.description: Feed and kill rates known to grow a recognisable pattern. Changing it morphs smoothly to the new pair.

props.name: feed
props.description: Feed rate of chemical A. Overrides the preset’s. Useful range 0.01–0.1.

props.name: kill
props.description: Kill rate of chemical B. Overrides the preset’s. Useful range 0.045–0.07.

props.name: speed
props.description: Simulation steps per frame. Higher grows faster and costs more.

props.name: seedText
props.description: Text drawn into the seed in the theme font, so it grows into the pattern. Use `\n` for a second line.

props.name: contain
props.description: With `seedText`, keep the pattern inside the letters so the words stay readable.

props.name: emboss
props.description: Pseudo-3D lighting on the concentration field, 0–1.

props.name: brushSize
props.description: Brush radius for painting chemical B, as a fraction of the shorter side.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the simulation on its current frame.

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the image for assistive tech. Without it the canvas is decorative and hidden.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when the simulation starts, or when it falls back.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
